results.title: Rajasthan Weather Update: Heavy Rainfall Expected in Three Districts
results.description: Rajasthan is bracing for heavy rainfall as the meteorological department issues alerts for three districts. While the monsoon has weakened recently, it is expected to regain strength in the coming days, bringing much-needed rain to various regions. Barmer has already recorded significant rainfall, leading to localized flooding. Residents are advised to stay cautious and farmers are encouraged to monitor weather updates for agricultural planning. The situation is evolving, and all eyes are on the next 48 hours as the monsoon is anticipated to become more active.

results.title: Education costs outpace incomes, fuel youth anger: Congress
results.description: Congress highlights rigged exams and rising education costs as key issues. Household expenditure data shows education expenses outpace income growth significantly. Private tuition and textbook costs are increasing at a rapid pace. Youth and parents demand immediate remedial actions for accessibility and affordability. This comes after Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned amid controversy.
